name: Hidane Oracle Corpus
description: The official Cloud Firestore emulator's answers that hidane records, replays and compares: every recording, how it was made, the release it was made against, and how its answers are compared. See docs/oracle-corpus.md.

recordings.compared: an error in full (code and message, its versions those of hidane's own commits), but a missing document on its code (its message prints the official emulator's internal key, an intentional difference); a success on its status; REST's `currentDocument.updateTime` parameter as intentionally different

recordings.counted: each commit over each transport it was recorded over, and each step that writes to or reads after another database
recordings.compared: in full: the first error's code and message, the number of write results or `:batchWrite`'s statuses, a read's status, names found or missing; a failed precondition without its message (it prints the official emulator's internal key); the cases the test lists in `KNOWN` (array unions of arrays and of vectors with NaN) and the steps in `DIFFERS` (writes to another database, which hidane refuses, and the reads that follow) as intentionally different

recordings.counted: each recorded message the tests check hidane's against (they replay no case as a whole); recorded over REST
recordings.compared: in full: the code and the message (a stored version's timestamps masked)

oracle.evidence: no header; tools/oracle/ names only cloud-firestore-emulator v1.22.0 at the commit that last changed it, as at the earlier commit that changed it

recordings.compared: in full: the names of every page, or the code and message; a page token next to an order as intentionally different

recordings.counted: each read at each age, the statuses of the writes to every database as one, and each read back
recordings.compared: in full: the code, the message and the names of the documents (gRPC), or the status and the body with server times and transaction IDs masked (REST); the reads from further back than hidane keeps versions, and the REST `?readTime=` parameter, as intentionally different (docs/parity-exceptions.md)

an error in full (code and message), but a failed precondition on its code (its message prints the official emulator's internal key, an intentional difference); a commit in full (its number of write results and the commit each one's update time comes from, or that it has none; the times themselves differ from run to run), in part where they hold transform results, which are not compared; a read in part (the fields and their order), a missing document on its code
a commit in full (its transform results, server times as the request time, or the code and message); a read in part (the document's fields), a missing document on its code
an error in full (status and message); results in part: every aggregate value with its type, not `done`, which gRPC does not carry
in full: the documents' names and fields but the vector (as the recording keeps them), the aggregate values, or the status and message

recordings.counted: each query but the `findNearest` one; recorded over REST

in full: the outcome as the recording summarises it
